_readme: The exact set of scripts/fixtures/eval/situations.json situation ids the engine (assets/decide.mjs) misses against THIS frozen fixture snapshot, each with a one-line reason. scripts/test-eval-situations.mjs asserts the miss set equals this list EXACTLY (a new miss or a newly-passing situation both fail that test) so a real behavior change is always reviewed and this file updated deliberately, never silently absorbed. Updated 2026-09-13 for cold key v2 (60 situations, 20 must-never rules; drafted by hand from standings positions, prices and cited pages, without reading decide.mjs): 59/60, must-never 20/20.

disagreements.reason: OpenAI-only exec-summaries, balanced: no OpenAI model clears the agreement bar. Engine starts with gpt-6-astra (tier 3 'tests-only', LiveBench position 8/34, no usage or votes yet) because the balanced reference cost comes from the best tier present; key expects gpt-5-6-sol (tested mid-table 25/34, chosen 2/8) on the reading that a people-backed model beats a tests-only one when neither clears. Honest disagreement about which weak-field evidence counts more; recorded, not forced.
